{{More citations needed|date=October 2021|talk=Untranslated refs in the reflist}}
{{Infobox Noble|reign-type=[[神武天皇]]の{{ill|Imperial Prince|ja|皇子|vi|Hoàng tử|zh|皇子|ko|황자|lt=Imperial Prince|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Imperial Prince|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}|birth_date=unknown|death_place={{ill|Yamato Province|en|Yamato Province|qid=Q907495|lt=Yamato Province}}|father={{ill|Emperor Jimmu|en|Emperor Jimmu|qid=Q200188|lt=Emperor Jimmu}}|mother={{ill|Ahiratsu-hime|en|Ahiratsu-hime|qid=Q10919837|lt=Ahiratsu-hime}}}}'''Kisumimi-no-mikoto'''<ref>『日本古代神祇事典』p341「きすみみのみこと（岐須美美命）」</ref> is a character in [[Japanese mythology]], a male deity and the son of the first Emperor {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|en|Emperor Jimmu|qid=Q200188|lt=Jimmu}}.<ref>『日本の神仏の辞典』p400「きすみみのみこと【岐須美美命】」</ref><ref>『日本の神様読み解き事典』p118「岐須美美命」</ref> He is the younger brother of {{ill|Tagishimimi|fa|تاگیشیمیمی|ja|手研耳命|zh|手研耳命|qid=Q11075750|lt=Tagishimimi}} and some speculate they were the same person.<ref>{{Cite web |last=日本人名大辞典+Plus |first=デジタル版 |title=岐須美美命とは |url=https://kotobank.jp/word/%E5%B2%90%E9%A0%88%E7%BE%8E%E7%BE%8E%E5%91%BD-1069200 |access-date=2022-01-12 |website=コトバンク |language=ja}}</ref> 

== References in the Kiki ==
The [[Nihon Shoki]] simple describes him and Tagishimimi as being born to {{ill|Ahiratsu-hime|en|Ahiratsu-hime|qid=Q10919837|lt=Ahiratsu-hime}} and {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|en|Emperor Jimmu|qid=Q200188|lt=Emperor Jimmu}}.<ref>{{Citation |title=Book III |url=https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Nihongi:_Chronicles_of_Japan_from_the_Earliest_Times_to_A.D._697/Book_III |work=Nihongi: Chronicles of Japan from the Earliest Times to A.D. 697, Volume 1 |access-date=2023-03-09}}</ref> without further mention
